Iconic Shipment Map Returns to Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Multiplayer

28 Oct 2026, 08:21 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Gaming Desk · Source: www.ign.com

1 min read

Key takeawaysCall of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has officially added Shipment to its multiplayer rotation. The fan-favorite map is now available in standard 6v6 playlists and a dedicated “Shipment 24/7” mode, commonly used by players for rapid kill farming and challenge progression.

Image: www.ign.com · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9; original source image

In this article
  1. Chaos Returns
  2. A Legacy Accident
  3. Looking Ahead

Chaos Returns

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has officially added Shipment to its multiplayer rotation. The fan-favorite map is now available in standard 6v6 playlists and a dedicated “Shipment 24/7” mode, commonly used by players for rapid kill farming and challenge progression.

A Legacy Accident

Originally introduced in 2007, Shipment was famously created as a temporary test environment for split-screen features. It was accidentally left in the final game build, but its fast-paced, high-intensity design quickly earned developer and player approval.

Looking Ahead

This update marks the game's first post-launch map. Additional content, including a likely battle pass and new features, is expected with the debut of the first seasonal update next week. Players can verify current playlist status directly in-game or through official channels at https://www.ign.com/articles/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-adds-series-favorite-map-shipment-to-multiplayer
